title: Morocco and AI: Who Is Accountable When the Model Enters Government?
hook_text: Who answers when AI runs government?
script:
Zoher Bijou published an opinion piece in Atalayar addressing AI accountability in Morocco.
Automated algorithms are moving into public administration and reshaping how civil services operate daily.
This shift forces policymakers to figure out who carries legal blame when systems fail.
Traditional bureaucratic frameworks struggle to assign fault between software vendors and government agencies.
Clear liability laws must catch up before automated tools take over critical citizen decisions.
Would you trust an automated system with your government paperwork?
